name: Doom Filter Down
notes: Use: doom and sludge riffs. Medium gain with FILTER nearly closed for a dark, thick, woolly wall; asymmetric clip adds even harmonics and a looser feel; the full low end stays (RUETZ off). Into a low-gain British amp (TONE3000 86089), dark cab. Single path, no captures: renders from files in this repo only (the shared cab is the repo identity IR, a stand-in for a real cab). Rat-style op-amp distortion model (pedal.rat, VERMIN). Starting hypotheses, not a tuned tone.
